senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (जषति)
To kill, to wound, to hurt or injure.

(इर उ) इर् जसु r. 4th cl. (जस्यति)
To liberate, to set free, to let loose.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (जसति जासयति)
1 To kill or injure.
2 To slight or disregard, to treat irreverently.
3 To strike, to punish with blows.
(इ) जसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (जंसति जंसयति)
To preserve, to protect.

m. (-रिः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
जस to kill or hurt, Uṇādi affix उरिन्.

n. (-कं)
A yellow fragrant wood.
E.
जष to hurt, affix ण्वुल्.
